prerequisites: FÍSICA I (No se requieren conocimientos previos)

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the level necessary to acquire the rest of the competencies of the degree, including notions of the latest advances.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; to choose and apply relevant established analytical, calculation, and experimental methods, and to correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems in their specialty; to choose and apply appropriate established analytical, calculation, and experimental methods; to recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.

Engineering projects: Ability to project, design, and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes, and systems in their specialty, that comply with established requirements, including being aware of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability and skill to plan and carry out experimental research, interpret results, and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project, and research, and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects, and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes, and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Judgment formulation: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Identifies and adequately calculates the operating parameters of a mechanical component that meets the needs of the system.
Evaluates possible alternatives regarding the mechanical subassembly to be designed and represents the most appropriate one, integrating commercial mechanical elements.
Makes decisions and assesses the possible consequences of the selected alternative.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and making correct use of language, in writing.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and making correct use of language orally.
Makes a correct representation of mechanical components, indicating the requirements that will guarantee the functioning of the assembly and defining the adapted material.
Coordinates their work with other team members, contributes to their team in the development of tasks to be carried out and the creation of a good working environment.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of a mechanical assembly (fits, mechanical elements, materials, etc.)
Generation of exploded views in 3D / 2D with their respective dimensional, surface, and geometric tolerances
Manufacturing tools (reference, support, and clamping systems)
Detailed design of tools (selection of commercial elements, assembly drawing and exploded views in 2D and/or 3D)

Design based on the specifications of a mechanical subassembly / component and drafting of a technical report (specifications notebook, generation of alternatives, assembly / exploded drawings considering materials to be used and manufacturing processes)

assessment_rules: The evaluation of the semester project is continuous; recovery and improvement are managed through project follow-up meetings and feedback sessions. For other project evaluations, work is analyzed before the final report to identify improvements, and the corrected final version serves as recovery. Written and oral individual tests can be recovered through further written and oral tests. For some project assessments, there are no specific recovery mechanisms beyond the continuous evaluation process.
